_comment: Example redaction patterns for the public export. Copy this file to governance/seguranca/redaction-patterns.json and replace the values with your own: your email, your machine name, your client slugs, the paths of your working directories. The export refuses to run without that file, and it never exports it.
_note_on_escapes: scripts/** is exported, so this very file is scanned. That is why a pattern must not contain its own target as a literal: use equivalent escapes (\u005Cx2D for a hyphen, \u005Cx5F for an underscore) or a one-character class such as [o]. The regex still matches the real string; the pattern text does not match itself.
